messages:
anya: Heads-up: Observability flagged a weird pattern after we flipped on strict fncall validation for the beta slice. Lots of rejects for the same request_id but different route_ids or none at all. Customers see multiple 4xx spikes in console.

jordan: are these actual duplicates (retries) or distinct failed inputs?

lee: dug into the logs, looks like LB retries are happening when upstream fncall adapter times out. The retry generates a new internal id but the validator error logs only have the internal validator_id, not the original request_id. Example (redacted):

```
2026-04-05T11:02:12Z ERROR validator fncall_reject reason=missing_field field=name validator_id=vld-9a customer=orpheus route_id=r-us-2
2026-04-05T11:02:12Z INFO proxy retry parent_req=abc-req-7 retry_id=abc-req-7-retry1 target=validator
```

lee: so console and billing see two different events for the same customer call: one with route_id and one without. We end up double-counting rejects and the per-route graph is noisy.

telemetry-bot: alert: duplicate_rejects ratio > 0.6 for beta slice in us-west.

anya: ok, two problems: 1) missing stable request_id in validator logs, 2) enrichment step that tags route info runs after validation and emits enriched events without a stable join key across retries.

jordan: proposal: generate a stable public request_id at the edge (proxy) and propagate it in X-Req-Id header through all retries. Validator should log that header when emitting rejects. Enricher can join on X-Req-Id to dedupe. Minimal change footprint.

lee: +1, but we also need to handle cases where third-party SDKs omit the header. Fallback: have the proxy synth one and propagate. Also include a retry_parent_id on all retries so we can group.

billing-svc: note: billing pipeline currently charges per 'fncall_response' event and decrements nothing for rejects. If we dedupe at telemetry, billing must consume deduped counts or we'll still bill customers twice. We need a dedup_key on enrich events that billing can use.

anya: what about timing? The enrolment/enricher might see the retry after the original reject has already been tallied. We need an idempotency window or a counterscope.

jordan: plan: 1) edge: synth X-Req-Id on ingress if missing (low risk), 2) validator: include x_req_id and retry_parent_id in reject event, 3) enricher: emit fncall_reject_enriched with dedup_key=x_req_id (and retry_parent_id), 4) telemetry pipeline: keep a 5-minute dedupe window keyed by dedup_key before finalizing counts, 5) billing: ignore rejects until enricher confirms dedupe status or mark billing_flag=deferred and finalize when dedupe window closes.

console-svc: UX ask: can we show a transient "possible duplicate rejects" indicator and collapse duplicates by dedup_key in the timeline? Also surface when enrichment is pending (e.g., "enriching...") so support doesn't freak out.

telemetry-bot: meta: this will add a cheap header to millions of requests. We should measure header size perf impact.

lee: micro-impl detail: use UUIDv4 for x_req_id; include Retry-Parent header with existing id when retrying. Validator change is trivial: read header and echo in logs. Enricher needs to dedupe and emit billing_flag=deferred|final. Sample enriched event:

```
{ "event":"fncall_reject_enriched", "x_req_id":"abc-req-7", "retry_parent":"abc-req-7", "route_id":"r-us-2", "reason":"missing_field", "billing_flag":"deferred" }
```

jordan: agree. For rollout, toggle for beta slice only. Ops: can we stage a telemetry-only run first (no billing changes) to validate dedupe false-positive rate?

billing-svc: yes we can accept billing_flag after a flag flip. For the first 24h we can keep billing unchanged and run a dry-run that logs what would have been charged. After validation flip billing to respect dedupe.

anya: action items:
- Lee: implement X-Req-Id synth and header propagation in proxy (ETA 8h)
- Jordan: patch validator to include x_req_id + retry_parent_id in reject logs and wire to enricher (ETA 6h)
- Telemetry: add 5m dedupe window + dry-run pipeline (ETA 24h)
- Billing: implement billing_flag handling and dry-run verify (ETA 48h)
- Console-svc: add UI state for "enrichment pending" and duplicate collapse (ETA 48h)

anya: also policy decision: during canary we should not count deferred rejects for quota enforcement until final dedupe decision. That prevents customers from hitting quota unexpectedly.

console-svc: FYI we'll put a banner on route errors: "Some recent rejects are being enriched/deduplicated  final counts may change." We'll link to support docs.

telemetry-bot: scheduled task: enable request-id synth on beta slice at 2026-04-05T14:00Z.

anya: good. Keep product + support in the loop; we should send an outbound note to affected customers explaining they're seeing repeated errors and we're consolidating counts.

jordan: one more thought: include validator_version in enriched event so we can track if a validator bug causes false rejects.

lee: added. I'll push a prototype and post sample logs in #eng-platform after deploy.

anya: thanks everyone. Let's reconvene after telemetry dry-run results.
